plugins.description: Reads your camt.053 bank statements: failed collections by bank reason code, the failure rate per collection day, the incoming payments booked by hand and the manual work they cause. Then this month's work, prepared: new attempts with a suggested day and customer mail drafts. Drafts only, nothing is sent. Twikey receives nothing.
